findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_translations" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: RETURNS QUOTABLE PASSAGES (page-level snippets + citation URLs), matched by KEYWORD/term. PICK THIS to find a quote or textual evidence on a topic across the wh…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_translations, share_findings, propose_collection · Private data: get_book_text · Public sink: submit_feedback, share_findings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_translations, share_findings, propose_collection · Private data: get_book_text · Public sink: submit_feedback, share_findings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
